title: Regulatory Amendments - Federal Reserve
summary: This is a Federal Reserve navigation page listing historical regulatory amendments related to primary and secondary credit rate changes at Federal Reserve Banks, spanning from 2008 to December 2025. The page is not a single archiveable document but rather a chronological index of individual notices documenting rate increases and decreases.
key_points: The page lists amendments to the Fed's primary and secondary credit rates dating from 2008 to late 2025
Most recent amendments documented: rate decreases effective December 19, 2025, November 14, 2025, October 2, 2025, and January 15, 2025
Historical rate increases documented from 2022-2023 as the Fed tightened policy
The listing also includes technical amendments such as the TALF program expiration (effective June 8, 2018)
Emergency lending procedure amendments (effective January 1, 2016) are documented
Each amendment notice links to a separate PDF document for specific details
why_it_matters: This page serves as an authoritative index for Fed discount window rate history. However, it contains no new analytical content and individual rate decisions must be accessed via linked PDFs.
market_structure_context: This page documents historical changes to the Fed's primary credit (discount window) rate and secondary credit rate. These rates are part of the Fed's lending facilities that serve as backstops to the banking system.
